title: Boop
blurb: A soft, friendly two-tone boop, the sound of tapping someone on the nose rendered in audio. It fills a niche the internet genuinely needs — wholesome without being saccharine, cute without demanding anything from you. Streamers wire it to channel-point redemptions. Editors drop it on gentle moments. Plenty of people press it simply because pressing a button labelled Boop and hearing a boop is a complete and satisfying experience in itself. Original synthesis, free to download, and the closest thing this soundboard has to a house sound.
origin: Original Bleepboard synthesis, the house boop.
